Detail: FINAL LOCKED production database package for Wajhatna Riyadh AI Decision Support Platform - 9 canonical tables, no further architectural decisions open unless a validation failure proves a locked assumption wrong

metro_stations has NO geom column (Option A, locked). Authoritative geometry lives exclusively in metro_station_lines, since interchange stations verified to have different coordinates (and in one case, S32, different station_type) per line. A representative point is available ONLY via the metro_stations_with_representative_geom VIEW, never as a second stored source-of-truth.
pois.type retains the source typo 'Mousque' verbatim (2074 records) - NOT silently corrected to 'Mosque'. Flagged here as a known source-quality issue, not fixed.
metro_stations station S07 has Arabic name 'stc' (Latin script) - this is the legitimate brand name (Saudi Telecom Company), not a data error.

2 POIs (Edge of the World / نهاية العالم, poi_id POI_002090/002091) sit ~30km outside the tight 99.9th-percentile cluster of the other 2775 POIs (lon 45.99 vs cluster 46.32-46.99). Classified as an ETL/spatial-preprocessing question for the ArcGIS Pro clip step, NOT resolved in this package - data unchanged.
94 source Metro_Stations rows -> 83 unique metro_stations (identity) + 94 metro_station_lines (junction, 1:1 with source). All other tables unchanged in row count from source.

Only 2 physical FKs exist in the entire schema (both within the metro_station_lines junction). bus_stops<->transit_routes is a verified 1:N logical join, not a junction table. All POI/Events/Holidays/Prayer_Times cross-table relationships are query-time only (spatial via PostGIS KNN, or temporal via date comparison) - zero stored FKs for these.
